items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I got a call from Louis Armstrong wanting me to come in right away.

ctx.x: And would you -- would they get records of bands, as well?
Oh, yeah, everything. Louis Armstrong. Everyone of us in our family could sing -- could hum every Louis Armstrong note. In fact, even that thing, "A Chocolate

Drop, that's me, because My Head Is Curly," and all that stuff. I like the way And on the solo, we'd sing it, everything and scat That's how it. My cousin, Duke, became like what they call the Texas offering of a Cab Calloway, you know. He had the long hair like the white man, you know. And he would do a Cab Calloway, and throw his hair all over his eyes, all those contortions.
